fixtures.title: Desktop app crash on export with an error code

follow_up_actions: Notify the caller via email when the bug is fixed.
output.call_summary: Marco Visser contacted support reporting that the Repak desktop app crashes when exporting reports. The agent confirmed the issue and advised using the web app as a workaround until a fix is released. A bug report was logged, and the caller's email was noted for notification.

fixtures.title: Work email not syncing on phone, fixed on call

output.issue_description: The caller's work email was not syncing on her Android phone using the standard mail app. New messages only appeared when she opened it on her laptop.

Check that background data is allowed for the mail app.
output.resolution_outcome: The issue was resolved by turning on background data for the mail app. The email started syncing normally again.
output.call_summary: Sophie Bakker called about her work email not syncing on her Android phone. The issue was resolved by enabling background data for the mail app. Sophie expressed gratitude for the quick and effective support.
